meta.title_note: The repository never uses 'Crownfall: Aethelgard' as a title. meta.method: Read-only. git fetch, then git show / ls-tree / grep / log on the remote branches. Asset text comes from SOURCES.md, provenance.json, licence files, handoff docs and package lockfiles. Private canon is not included.

unconfirmed: Game title: 'Crownfall: Aethelgard' does not appear in any branch. The repo uses 'Crownfall — King's Gambit' and 'Crownfall — A King's Gambit Story'; 'Aethelgard' is the internal My Legacy world name. Confirm the title card.

Soundtrack: the creator confirmed 'Music by Osita Miles' for all six tracks (8 Nov 2026), but only track 3's file carries an artist tag (myles4miles), and it also says 'made with suno'. Whether to show a Suno note beside the music credit, and whether the other five tracks used Suno, is for the creator to decide; the files do not say.
Original author or tool for the supplied Play-card, Home and loading artwork is not recorded. The originals came from a private ChatGPT Page.

Four-armed sorcerer: 'user-provided creature and its commissioned editing output'. No modeller or commissioned editor is named. The rig is described as a 'Mixamo body plus four arms'; whether Adobe Mixamo was used, and on what terms, is not recorded.
Elderbloom village (Ealdholt base): the Fab listing, author and distribution scope are not recorded. Fab Standard License (NoAI) comes from Claude's mirror note.

Baked battlefields (release gameport-2026-11-03): the GLBs are outside Git, and README mentions 'the artist' without a name. Which arena sources (scans, ambientCG, Poly Haven, KitBash3D, Meshy) survive in the shipped files is unverified.
KitBash3D 'Secrets of the Luminara': licence terms not recorded, and the kit's textures were never supplied.
Arena Poly Haven texture authors are not in the committed tree (assets/CFCL_PBR/SOURCES.json was omitted from the backup). The Codex v002 'CC0 banks' source register was not committed.
Capitoline Museum Courtyard and Mercati di Traiano: downloaded, but integration is not recorded. Their CC BY lines are included because SOURCES.md says to put them in the game's credits.
Alex Nguyen: authored the upstream initial commit and owns the upstream repo name (alexngdev99). The 19 Rork commits are agent-authored, and the human prompting Rork is not named.
Rork-generated figures and audio: the underlying generation services are not recorded.
Cael campaign portrait: described as 'generated'; the generator is not recorded.
Cinzel and Crimson Pro (King's Gambit chess app): loaded from Google Fonts; designer and licence are not recorded in the repo.
Barlow: the repo names 'The Barlow Project Authors' only, not an individual designer.
Commits authored as Osita Miles / mylife-as-miles mix creator and Codex work. The agent behind the 25-26 Oct desktop and Quest menu commits is not recorded.
The Quest UIKit runtime ships @pmndrs/msdfonts (redistributes Google Fonts such as Roboto, Apache-2.0). Whether any default MSDF face is visible in the Quest UI is not verified.
Blender's licence is not recorded in the repository.
